situations.title: 노인 청력 고려 소통
situations.tagline: I can't hear you too well, honey — could you say that a little louder and look at me?
situations.brief: 청력이 저하된 노인 환자와 눈을 맞추고 천천히 또박또박 확인하며 수술 전 안내를 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me face you so you can see my lips.
I'll speak slowly and check that you understand.
Please tell me if you need me to repeat anything.

situations.title: 소아 보호자 동반 안내
situations.tagline: Can I stay with my son until he falls asleep? He's really scared without me.
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 보호자에게 마취 유도까지 동반 가능 여부와 절차를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: You can stay with him until he's asleep.
I'll walk you through what to expect in the room.
We'll help him feel safe the whole time.

situations.title: 노인 피부 상태 사정
situations.tagline: My skin bruises so easily these days — is that going to be a problem for the surgery?
situations.brief: 노인 환자의 취약한 피부와 기존 손상 부위를 확인하고 압박 손상 예방을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking your skin for any fragile or bruised areas.
We'll pad the pressure points to protect you.
Let me know if any spot feels sore right now.

situations.title: 소아 체중 기준 준비
situations.tagline: You need his exact weight? We weighed him this morning — is the dose based on that?
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 정확한 체중을 확인해 체중 기반 약물 용량 준비의 이유를 보호자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We dose his medications by his exact weight.
Let me confirm the weight we have on file.
This keeps everything safe and accurate for him.
goals: 체중 기반 용량 준비의 필요성을 설명한다

situations.title: 노인 인지 상태 확인
situations.tagline: What day is it? Oh — I get a little mixed up, but I know I'm here for my knee.
situations.brief: 노인 환자의 기저 인지 상태를 부드럽게 사정해 수술 전 기준선을 파악하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me your name and where you are today?
There are no wrong answers — just take your time.
I'm noting how you're doing so we can compare later.

situations.title: 소아 금식 시간 안내
situations.tagline: She had a little juice at breakfast — is that okay, or does it push the surgery back?
situations.brief: 소아 금식 지침을 보호자에게 설명하고 마지막 섭취 시간을 정확히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did she last have anything to eat or drink?
Clear liquids and solids have different cutoff times.
This keeps her safe during anesthesia.

situations.title: 노인 다약제 정리
situations.tagline: I take about nine pills a day — I brought the list, but I'm not sure which ones I took today.
situations.brief: 노인 환자의 복용약을 정리해 polypharmacy 상호작용과 오늘 복용 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's go through each medication one at a time.
Which of these did you take this morning?
I'll flag any that could interact with anesthesia.

situations.title: 소아 분리 불안 완화
situations.tagline: He won't let go of my hand — please, is there any way to make this easier for him?
situations.brief: 부모와 떨어지기 힘들어하는 소아의 분리 불안을 중재하고 보호자를 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: We can bring his favorite toy into the room.
You'll stay right beside him until he's asleep.
Let's make this feel like a calm, safe game for him.
goals: 소아의 분리 불안을 완화하는 방법을 제안한다

situations.title: 노인 낙상 위험 이송
situations.tagline: I get dizzy when I move — please hold on to me, I don't want to fall off this bed.
situations.brief: 낙상 위험이 높은 노인 환자의 이송 중 안전을 확보하고 낙상을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: I've got the side rails up and I'm right here with you.
Please don't try to move on your own — let us do the work.
We'll go slowly and keep you steady the whole way.

situations.title: 소아 정맥로 확보 배려
situations.tagline: She's terrified of needles — can you numb it first so the IV doesn't hurt so much?
situations.brief: 소아의 정맥로 확보 시 통증과 불안을 줄이는 배려 방법을 보호자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll use numbing cream before the IV.
You can hold her and help keep her calm.
We'll do it as quickly and gently as possible.
goals: 소아 IV 확보의 통증·불안 완화 방법을 설명한다

situations.title: 노인 섬망 위험 선별
situations.tagline: After my last surgery I was confused for days — is that going to happen again this time?
situations.brief: 노인 환자의 수술 전 섬망 위험 인자를 선별하고 예방 계획을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Have you ever felt confused after surgery before?
We'll take steps to lower the risk of delirium.
Keeping your glasses and hearing aids nearby helps.
goals: 수술 전 섬망 위험 인자를 선별한다

situations.title: 소아 최근 감염·접종 확인
situations.tagline: She had a runny nose last week and just got her flu shot — does any of that affect the surgery?
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 최근 감염 증상과 예방접종 이력을 확인해 마취 위험을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Has she had any fever, cough, or cold recently?
When did she get her last vaccination?
A recent infection can affect anesthesia safety.
goals: 최근 감염 증상과 접종 이력을 확인한다

situations.title: 노인 저체온 취약성
situations.tagline: I'm freezing already — I always get so cold in these rooms, is there a warm blanket?
situations.brief: 열손실에 취약한 노인 환자의 저체온을 예방하기 위한 보온 조치를 준비하고 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll bring you a warmed blanket right now.
We'll use a warming device during your surgery.
Staying warm helps you heal and stay safe.

situations.title: 소아 연령별 설명법
situations.tagline: Is the sleepy medicine going to hurt? I don't want a big needle.
situations.brief: 발달 단계에 맞춰 소아 환자에게 마취와 수술 과정을 이해하기 쉬운 말로 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The sleepy medicine works like a magic mask, no big needle.
You'll take a nap and wake up when it's all done.
You're being so brave — I'll be right here with you.
goals: 발달 단계에 맞는 말로 과정을 설명한다

situations.title: 노인 사전연명의향 확인
situations.tagline: I have a living will — I want you to know I don't want to be kept on machines.
situations.brief: 노인 환자의 DNR 및 사전연명의향을 수술 전에 존중하며 정확히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for telling me about your living will.
Let's make sure your wishes are on the record for today.
The team will discuss how this applies during surgery.

situations.title: 노인 응급 인지저하 동의
situations.tagline: Dad can't understand the consent — I'm his healthcare proxy, what do you need from me right now?
situations.brief: 인지 저하 노인 환자의 응급 수술을 위해 대리 동의를 신속히 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: As his proxy, you can consent on his behalf.
I'll get the surgeon to explain the risks to you now.
We need to move quickly, so let's confirm your authority.

situations.title: 소아 유도 중 후두경련 위험
situations.tagline: He's spasming down and I can't ventilate — deepen him and get me succinylcholine now.
situations.brief: 소아 마취 유도 중 후두경련 위험을 즉시 인지하고 기도 위기 대응을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll apply positive pressure and jaw thrust now.
Succinylcholine is drawn up and ready.
I'm calling for backup and the difficult airway cart.
goals: 응급 기도 약물과 장비를 신속히 준비한다

situations.title: 노쇠 환자 수술 위험 재논의
situations.tagline: He's frailer than the chart suggests — I think we need to revisit the risk before we proceed.
situations.brief: 고위험 노쇠 환자의 수술 위험을 재평가해 팀과 즉시 논의하세요.
keyPhrases: His frailty markers put him at high risk today.
Let's page the surgeon to reassess before induction.
I want anesthesia to weigh in on this plan.

situations.title: 소아 급성 탈수·저혈량
situations.tagline: This kid's tachy and his cap refill is delayed — he's hypovolemic, let's bolus before we induce.
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 급성 탈수와 저혈량을 인지하고 수액 긴급 보정을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll draw up a weight-based fluid bolus now.
His heart rate and cap refill say he's dry.
Let's hold induction until his volume improves.
goals: 체중 기반 수액 보정을 신속히 준비한다

situations.title: 노인 심혈관 불안정 도착
situations.tagline: His pressure's dropping and the rhythm looks off — I need you to call anesthesia and the surgeon now.
situations.brief: 심혈관계가 불안정한 노인 환자의 도착을 인지하고 즉시 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: His blood pressure and rhythm are unstable.
I'm getting a fresh set of vitals and an EKG.
Paging anesthesia and the surgeon to the bedside.

situations.title: 미숙아 체온 위기
situations.tagline: Her temp is crashing — get the isolette warmer up and wrap her, we can't let her get cold.
situations.brief: 미숙아의 급격한 체온 저하를 인지하고 신생아 체온을 긴급히 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm raising the room and warmer temperature now.
Let's wrap her and use warmed fluids and gases.
I'll keep monitoring her temp every few minutes.
